feature.title: Notes beside a chapter
feature.problem: While reading a chapter there is no place to write. The only route is selecting text and pressing Add to notes, which creates a new page every time and takes you nowhere: you can't type your own words next to the text, and a chapter's notes end up scattered across many pages.
nonGoals: Inline margin annotations anchored to paragraphs.
Notes beside project briefs (same panel later, not now).
A new editor: the panel uses the Notes page's block editor.

surfaces.name: Chapter with notes

moments.peak: you type a thought next to the paragraph that prompted it, without leaving the chapter
moments.end: the chapter finished, and its notes page holds your words and the passages you quoted, one click from Notes

surfaces.purpose: Read the chapter and write about it side by side.

states.loading: Two text skeleton lines in the panel while the chapter's note loads.
states.empty: No note yet: the editor is open and empty with the placeholder 'Write about this chapter'; the page is created on the first keystroke, not on open.
states.error: Compact ErrorState in the panel: 'Your notes didn't load' with Try again; the chapter stays readable.
states.success: The block editor with the chapter's note; it saves after a pause in typing and shows Saving / Saved.

components.why: notes sit beside the text you're reading and stay put while you scroll; the same drag handle as the tutor panel, so widths behave the same
one editor across the app: chapter mentions, diagram and quiz blocks all work, and the page opens unchanged in Notes
one obvious way in, next to Ask the tutor; remembered so a note-taker doesn't reopen it every chapter
